_comment: Source images → public/images/<key>.webp (max 1280px wide) + <key>-640.webp. Run `npm run images` after editing. crop = [top, height], cropX = [left, width] in source pixels (full extent when omitted).
_everyai_sources: Owner's Notion export, 2026-10-10 (read-only, crops in source pixels): main.png = 로그인(JWT).gif frame 94, x270 y0 790x1012 (app column only: no Bandisoft watermark, no devtools); service-detail.png = 부트페이_1.gif frame 0, x565 y0 775x1000 (app column, watermark and grey margins excluded); payment-message.png = 안전_결제_2.gif frame 132, x1048 y140 762x767 (right browser window's chat area only: no browser chrome, taskbar, URL or watermark); admin-banners.png = 광고_배너_리스트.png, x0 y40 1700x640 (close button and empty area removed).
_second_brain_source: graph.webp = owner-supplied pre-blurred Obsidian graph (labels blurred on purpose; never replace with the unblurred original).
_life_sources: Owner photos, privacy-processed by the command post (bystanders cropped, brand labels blurred, metadata stripped). workingholiday shows the owner's face: path row 2025 only, never the hub portrait. oliveyoung (mirror selfie in a work shirt; brand already named in the 2025 copy) and clothing-shop (stock only, no people) are pre-cropped to 4:3 here.
_portrait_source: portrait.webp: owner's mirror selfie (metadata stripped by the command post). Cropped 4:5 on head and upper body; the store's left poster is outside the crop.
